contradicted_points.text: CCTV and scene evidence strongly indicate the stockroom window was worked on from outside and person with the tool climbed through it, which conflicts person with the tool customer-door entry as the initial entry.
The customer door and showroom were found intact and undisturbed, leaving the method of customer-door entry unexplained.
The identities of the two people from the van are not established, and no face or van registration was recorded.
The cleaner heard a van considerably earlier than the van timing in the CCTV log, so the relationship between those timings remains unsettled on the available records.
